notes: The tuition quote is from the programme's own DAAD page and covers this programme generally; the separate TUM page on tuition fees for non-EU students was not used because its amounts (2,000 or 3,000 EUR per semester) are general and the DAAD page states no tuition fees for this programme. The 'acceptedTests' for German (delf-dalf) was inferred from the DAAD page's mention of the Goethe-Zertifikat A2 and other certificates; however, the quote does not explicitly name these tests, so the acceptedTests list is empty (the language certificate itself must be provided). The English B2 rule is listed as a requirement even though the proof is via placement test/interview. Documents: the DAAD page lists a 'Letter of motivation' and 'Complete up-to-date resume' as items an applicant must provide; these are included. The VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) from uni-assist is required for international applicants and is reflected in the applicationChannel. No tuition amount in EUR was specified as a number for non-EU students on the DAAD page, so the amount is set to 0 based on the explicit statement of no tuition fees. Intakes: only a date range (15 May to 15 July) is given without a year, so no ISO dates are output.
